description:
Stafford Gray is seeking an experienced SharePoint Online developer to help build a modernized claims processing system for a Florida state agency. The project replaces a legacy system with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, and Azure Government. This role owns the document management side of the solution and its integration with Dynamics 365.
 This is a fully remote contract role with an expected implementation of about two years. 
 Responsibilities:
 Design and configure SharePoint Online sites, libraries, metadata, content types, and permissions for claims documents
 Build workflow automation with Power Automate and integrate SharePoint with Dynamics 365 and Dataverse
 Configure enterprise search, versioning, and retention policies to meet records and compliance requirements
 Support document migration, linking, indexing, and validation with the data migration team
 Troubleshoot access, workflow, metadata, and integration issues, and document configurations
 Work with the technical lead, Power Platform developers, and business stakeholders on secure, maintainable designs
 Requirements 
 Required:
 5+ years of SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 development
 Strong experience with Power Automate, document libraries, metadata, and content types
 Experience configuring search, versioning, and retention policies
 Experience integrating SharePoint with Dynamics 365, Dataverse, or similar CRM platforms
 Must be based in the U.S.
 Available for contract work; we work directly with candidates, not through third-party vendors
 Preferred:
 Experience with insurance, legal, claims, or other compliance-driven document processes
 Experience migrating legacy documents or workflows to SharePoint Online
 Government or regulated industry experience
 Microsoft 365 or Power Platform certifications
 Benefits 
 Compensation: $70 to $80 per hour on a 1099 basis, depending on experience. W2 is also available.
 Contract length: approximately two years, with potential extension.
 Schedule: fully remote, U.S. based.
